description: p9's input, which claims no independence, with `x_undefined: 1` added to its first attestation. The criterion does not read the attestations of a record that claims nothing, but each one is a closed object all the same, so the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p9 is the accepting twin. An engine that checks the attestations only when independence is claimed accepts this vector. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json.
